results.question: One of my reports got a rating of 1. What happens to them, and what increment do they get?
results.answer: An employee rated 1 is placed on a 60-day performance improvement plan with documented, measurable goals, requiring the involvement of the HR business partner from the start and check-ins with the manager every two weeks [1]. Additionally, managers must bring written evidence for a rating of 1 to the calibration meeting before ratings are finalized [5]. Regarding their salary, an employee with a rating of 1 receives no annual increment [3].
